description:
Keyword Autocomplete Scraper: Google, YouTube, Amazon, Bing

Every autocomplete suggestion for your keywords from Google, YouTube, Bing, Amazon and DuckDuckGo as JSON: suggestion, engine, rank and the expanded query that produced it. Alphabet and question expansion, no API key. From $0.30 per 1,000 suggestions.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Autocomplete suggestion scraped: $0.0003.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/keyword-autocomplete-suggestions.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

concurrency.description: How many keyword/engine tasks run in parallel (1-20, default 5). Each task sends its expanded queries one after another (up to 37 requests with alphabet expansion), so 5 is already gentle on the engines' rate limits.
concurrency.title: Concurrency

country.description: Two-letter country code for the suggestions, e.g. us, gb, de, jp, my. Sent as gl to Google/YouTube and used to pick the Amazon marketplace (US, GB, DE, JP and IN have their own; other countries fall back to the US marketplace). DuckDuckGo's autocomplete ignores it.
country.title: Country

dedupe.description: When true (default), a suggestion that an engine already returned for the same keyword is delivered once, even when a later expanded query returns it again (e.g. "coffee" from both "coffee" and "coffee shop"). Duplicates are counted in the run log.
dedupe.title: De-duplicate suggestions

engines.description: Which autocomplete engines to query: google (Google Search), youtube (YouTube), bing (Bing), amazon (Amazon product search) or duckduckgo (DuckDuckGo). Default ["google"]. Pick several to compare what each engine suggests for the same keyword.
engines.title: Engines

expand.description: none queries only the seed. alphabet also queries the seed plus a-z and 0-9 (37 queries per keyword and engine). questions also queries the seed plus who/what/where/when/why/how/can/is/are/does and vs/for/near (14 queries per keyword and engine). Expansion is how you harvest suggestions the plain seed never returns.
expand.title: Expansion mode

keywords.description: Seed keywords to collect autocomplete suggestions for, e.g. ["coffee", "running shoes"]. Duplicates and blank entries are dropped. Up to 10,000 per run.
keywords.title: Keywords (seeds)

language.description: Interface language for the suggestions, e.g. en, de, es, ja, pt-BR. Sent as hl to Google/YouTube, setlang to Bing and accept-language to Amazon. DuckDuckGo's autocomplete ignores it (the value is still written to every row).
language.title: Language

maxItems.description: Maximum number of suggestion rows delivered in one run (1-100,000, default 1,000). Counts delivered suggestions only: free empty/error status rows do not use up the cap. Default 1,000 costs $0.30.
maxItems.title: Max rows (suggestions)

maxSuggestionsPerKeyword.description: How many suggestions to keep for each keyword on each engine (1-1,000, default 200). Expansion stops for that keyword/engine once the limit is reached.
maxSuggestionsPerKeyword.title: Max suggestions per keyword and engine

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Plain HTTP works and is the default; switch on Apify Proxy if an engine starts rate-limiting your runs or if you need suggestions as seen from another country.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

name: keyword_suggestions
